country: International: DCVAS recruited from 136 sites in 32 countries (MPA-specific country distribution not reported in main text; most patients from Europe, Asia and North America)
setting: Academic and community practices; majority academic rheumatology or nephrology units (referral bias acknowledged)
diagnostic_definition: Reference diagnosis of MPA after expert panel review (55 experts; only cases agreed on with at least moderate certainty retained): 269 of 404 cases retained the submitting physician diagnosis of MPA plus 22 reclassified as MPA by consensus of two expert reviewers. Classification study; comparators (n=822) excluded from this cohort.
inclusion_criteria: DCVAS: age >=18 years, diagnosis of vasculitis or vasculitis mimic; AAV only enrolled within 2 years of diagnosis; consecutive patients; only data present at diagnosis recorded. Cohort = MPA cases used in the stage-5 analysis (development n=149 + validation n=142).
exclusion_criteria: 135 submitted MPA cases that did not pass expert review were excluded.
registry: DCVAS (Diagnostic and Classification Criteria in Vasculitis) prospective observational study
notes: Table 1 reports the combined development+validation MPA cases (n=291); no feature data per development/validation set in the main text. Denominator of features = 291 unless stated.

diagnostic_definition: Submitting-physician diagnosis of MPA, before expert panel review (sensitivity analysis population: n=404 MPA cases and 2467 randomly selected comparators among 2871 DCVAS patients). Less well defined than C1.
inclusion_criteria: All DCVAS cases submitted with a diagnosis of MPA by the physician
notes: 269 of these 404 are part of C1 (291). Not independent of C1. Only one value extracted (pANCA/MPO-ANCA 91%).

diagnostic_definition: Identical to SUPPIAH2022_ARD_C1 (same study published simultaneously in Arthritis & Rheumatology)
notes: Duplicate publication of the same patients. No observations extracted from this publication to avoid double counting; numbers were checked as identical to the ARD version.
Duplicate publication of SUPPIAH2022_ARD_C2; no observations extracted.
